title: Hosted API intake rubric & enterprise triage for conversational, streaming, tool-calling, and structured-output requests
creator: Ethan Clarke
description: Create a repeatable product-management intake and prioritization framework for Hosted API feature requests coming from enterprise customers and high-usage self-serve accounts. Focus areas include chat UX and scale requirements, streaming semantics and resumability, function/tool-calling schemas and contract guarantees, and structured-output (JSON/schema) validation and error handling. Deliver a decision rubric, example scoring, required engineering and security gates, and a lightweight intake form to enforce consistent information capture.
acceptance_criteria: A concise intake form template (fields documented) used by PMs and SEs for all inbound Hosted API feature requests
A 4-point prioritization rubric that balances customer value, engineering effort, SLA risk, and security/compliance needs
Documented enterprise-specific requirements and mandatory gates (VPC, audit logs, SLA thresholds, KMS) for Hosted API features
Example triage decisions (3 customer requests) showing rubric scoring and final prioritization rationale
Kickoff of RFC with engineering and security with explicit success criteria and rollout plan for at least one feature area (streaming or function-calling)
outcome_goals: Reduce back-and-forth during intake by 50% (measured by follow-up questions per request)
Increase clarity for engineering on acceptance criteria and security constraints to shorten discovery from 3 weeks to 1 week
Ensure enterprise requests are routed to Dedicated/Private readiness checks when required, preventing accidental Hosted-only assumptions
stakeholders: Customer Success reps: Maya Torres, Omar Singh
next_steps: Run 1:1s with top 5 enterprise requestors to collect canonical use-cases and failure modes (owner: Marisol)
Draft intake form and share with SEs + CS for trial on next 10 requests (owner: Ethan)
Hold architecture sync with runtime and infra to confirm constraints for streaming/resumable sessions (owner: Liam)
Produce RFC skeleton for function-calling guarantees (ordering, idempotency, schema validation) and assign engineering owners
Add security gates: list of required artifacts for security review (KMS setup, audit log retention, data residency)
